title: The Pelican Brief
author: John Grisham
summary: After two Supreme Court justices are assassinated, a law student writes a theory about who was behind it. When her brief reaches the wrong people, she becomes a target and has to run.
readIf: you want a fast, paranoid, on-the-run conspiracy thriller.
skipIf: you want realism, as the plot is more about momentum than plausibility.

pairings.reason: Another Grisham thriller where a clever young lawyer discovers the people around her are dangerous.
A more action-heavy and international story of an individual hunted by a hidden network.
